page.overview:
Who is John?

He is seen in Paris kissing Nancy on the Pont des Arts as Mater, Finn McMissile and Holley Shiftwell drive by, with Mater catching sight of the couple.

When Lightning McQueen turns on Mack's TV, archive footage with John and Nancy is seen on one channel.
